warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) ACCORDING TO THE SURGEON GENERAL, WOMEN SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES DURING PREGNANCY BECAUSE OF THE RISK OF BIRTH DEFECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A CAR OR OPERATE MACHINERY, AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS.
notes: One flat can wrap, so there is a single image.

Two names are printed. 'OKTOBERFEST' is the largest text, arched across the top; 'KEYWORTH' over 'BREWING COMPANY' is a framed logo at the right. The reading above is the arched name in the brand position; the brewery logo is the other candidate.
The bottom banner reads '1 PINT (16 FL OZ)   6% ALC/VOL 19 IBU' on one line. The alcohol wording has no full stops and no space around the slash, and '19 IBU' follows it directly.
Warning is printed small at the bottom left over the illustration, in capitals, with 'GOVERNMENT WARNING:' on its own line above the body.

The marks after 'GENERAL' and after 'MACHINERY' are transcribed as commas, which the wording calls for, but the image cannot settle comma against full stop, and the measurement below is why. Ink is grey below 150 against a paper near 230, and the warning's capitals are 8 rows tall. Each of the four marks in the block is one column wide with ink over two rows: the suspect mark after GENERAL at x 206, greys 161 and 139 on y 829-830 against a baseline of y 830; the suspect mark after MACHINERY at x 253, greys 160, 120 and 159 on y 888-890 against a baseline of y 889; and the two certain full stops, DEFECTS. at x 248, greys 148 and 165 on y 859-860 against a baseline of y 859, and PROBLEMS. at x 181, greys 181 and 151 on y 903-904 against a baseline of y 904. The test that would separate the two shapes - whether the mark drops below the baseline - gives one row below for one certain full stop (DEFECTS.) and none for the other (PROBLEMS.), so the certain marks bracket the suspect ones and the test cannot decide them. The label's one certain comma at a larger size, in 'NORTH RICHLAND HILLS, TX' where the capitals are 14 rows tall, is at x 1373-1375, y 884-888: three columns wide, five rows tall, descending two rows below its baseline of y 886. Scaled to the warning's 8-row capitals that comma would be under two columns wide and under three rows tall, descending about one row, which is inside the one-row spread the four marks already show.
